title: Internal comparisons are not physical sink evidence
observations: The historical r109 record reported completed software checks and a black panel.
interpretation: Separate in-memory comparison, panel visibility and instrumented sink measurements.
counterevidence: A later run recorded a visible image; this does not establish the cause of the earlier black panel.
unresolved_questions: What does a current independent sink measurement establish?

source_references.summary: Historical physical observation, not current evidence.
